short_description: United States-based (San Diego, California) New York Times bestselling business-book author, keynote speaker and startup and enterprise-innovation advisor, best known as the co-author of the Lean Entrepreneur (with Patrick Vlaskovits, 2013) and the author of Disruption Proof. Brant Cooper is co-founder and Chief Executive Officer of Moves the Needle, a firm that applies lean, human-centred design and agile methodologies to help large enterprises adopt startup-style innovation practices. He is publicly recognised as one of the originators of the Lean Startup movement.
